hero.name: National Palace Museum main building
hero.silhouette: Long, symmetrical palace-style hall with a hip-and-gable roof, raised on a broad terrace reached by a wide central stairway, set against a wooded hill

crop: The central axis of the museum: the entrance archway, the long approach and stairways rising to the main building, with the forested hillside directly behind it. Not the whole Shilin campus or surrounding gardens.
orientation: Building backs onto the forested hills of Waishuangxi; the approach rises toward it along a single central axis (verify: compass direction of the axis)
